listen_addr.description: IP address on which the 9P server listens for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: TCP port number for the 9P server (standard 9P port is 564).

export_root.description: Absolute path to the directory tree exported via 9P. Must be accessible by the diod process user.

maxfiles.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed per client connection.

auth_mode.description: Authentication method for client connections. 'none' = no auth, 'user' = Unix username auth, 'cert' = TLS certificate auth.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate file (PEM format), required when auth_mode='cert'.

server_cert_path.description: Path to the server certificate file (PEM format), required when auth_mode='cert'.

server_key_path.description: Path to the server private key file (PEM format), required when auth_mode='cert'.

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity level for the server.

items.description: IP address or CIDR subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') allowed to connect.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses or subnets. Empty list means all clients are allowed.

items.description: IP address or CIDR subnet to explicitly deny.

denied_clients.description: List of denied client IP addresses or subnets. Deny rules take precedence over allow rules.

workers.description: Number of worker threads to handle I/O requests. Increase for higher throughput.

nodelay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY to disable Nagle’s algorithm for lower latency (recommended for 9P).

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of connection inactivity before the server closes the connection (0 = no timeout).

chroot_enabled.description: Whether to chroot the diod process to the export root directory for security.
